narrative.overview:
Pot Filler does not have a world of its own. It is a sibling app in the MC Bank family and inherits MC Bank's visual world wholesale: graphite surfaces with a faint lean towards the icon's green, Figtree Variable throughout, a deep icon-green that owns every action, amber only for a real shortfall or something to act on, teal for money in and "full", and grouped lists under small grey labels with totals on the right. The source of that world is MC Bank (the FinPair project's `src/style.css`); this file records how it landed in Pot Filler's own build. **Keep it in step with MC Bank.** When the family's look changes, change it there first and follow it here; never let the two drift into separate identities.

The screen reads as one exact ledger. Each account's shortfall is the headline figure, the pots sit beneath it as a grouped list, and after a run the screen always says what happened in plain words with drawn icons. Density is comfortable, not sparse: rows are 64px tall in a single column no wider than 560px, built for one thumb on an Android phone.

Dark is the default; each phone can choose Light, or System to follow the phone's own setting live (resolved to `data-theme="light"` on the root before first paint). Both themes are first-class and share every role; only the values move.
keyCharacteristics: Inherited from MC Bank: same palette roles, typeface, radii and list grammar.
Dark by default, light opt-in per phone; every role defined for both.
Colour is semantic, never decorative: green acts, amber means "not enough" or "act on this", teal is in, red has failed. Ordinary amounts are plain text.
Flat tonal layering in dark; a hairline ambient shadow in light.
One typeface, hierarchy by size and weight, tabular numerals on every money figure.
Drawn stroke icons on a 24px grid, one family throughout.

rules.name: The Green Means Go Rule
rules.body: Icon green marks what you can act on and where real money moves: primary buttons, switches that are on, the selected Live segment, focus. It never decorates, and Practice never wears it (Practice selects in neutral graphite, as MC Bank's segments do).

rules.name: The One Meaning Per Hue Rule
rules.body: Amber is only "not enough money" or "act on this", teal is only money in or full, red is only failure. A pot that still needs money is plain text, not amber; once filled it reads teal. Never use amber for ordinary amounts, and never swap hues for visual variety.

rules.name: The In Step With MC Bank Rule
rules.body: These values are MC Bank's. A palette change starts in the family's source and is copied here, never invented here.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every money figure uses tabular numerals so amounts align down the list and don't jitter while a run updates them.

rules.name: The Shortfall Is The Headline Rule
rules.body: On the main screen the largest type is the account's amount to fill (headline, plain text; amber only when the account can't cover it). Nothing else in the account section is set larger.

rules.name: The Thumb Reach Rule
rules.body: The account's one action is a full-width 54px button inside its summary card, directly under the figure it acts on, not at the top of the screen.

rules.name: The Flat Dark Rule
rules.body: In dark, separate surfaces by graphite step, never by shadow or border. Shadows exist for the sheet and small controls only.

rules.name: The Pill For Small Rule
rules.body: Small buttons (36px), icon buttons (44px) and switches are full pills; full-width actions are rounded rectangles. Don't make a big button a pill or a small one a rectangle.

dos: **Do** take every palette, type and radius decision from MC Bank and keep Pot Filler in step with it.
**Do** define every colour role for both themes; dark is the default and light is opt-in per phone.
**Do** reserve icon green for actions, switches that are on, focus and the selected Live segment.
**Do** keep ordinary amounts in plain text; amber only for "not enough" or something to act on, teal for money in and full, red for failures.
**Do** set every money figure in tabular numerals, with the account's shortfall as the largest figure (30px, 700).
**Do** use the drawn 24px, 2px-stroke icon family for every icon.
**Do** separate surfaces by graphite step in dark and by a hairline ambient shadow in light.
**Do** keep a disabled primary button's label readable (faint text on raised graphite at full opacity).
donts: **Don't** invent a separate Pot Filler palette, typeface or icon style; it is an MC Bank sibling.
**Don't** use teal or amber for buttons or selection; green acts.
**Don't** colour Practice green; only Live wears it.
**Don't** add a second typeface or fall back to a system display face for headings.
**Don't** add card shadows or borders in dark mode.
**Don't** put a failure in a red-filled box; a problem is a hairline section with a red heading and a plain fix.
**Don't** set section labels in uppercase with tracking; group labels are small grey sentence case. The mock banner's caps are the family's dev marker, not a label style.
**Don't** use text glyphs or emoji as icons.
